sections.title: Annual herb
sections.text: Fenugreek is an aromatic annual, usually up to 50 cm tall. Each leaf has three toothed leaflets; small pale-yellow to whitish flowers give way to long, narrow pods, about 8–19 cm long, with a beak.

sections.title: Seeds and leaves
sections.text: The seeds are a familiar spice and have a maple-like aroma; the leaves are also used as food. NCCIH distinguishes ordinary food amounts from larger supplement doses: high doses can cause digestive effects or lower blood sugar, and amounts above food use are not considered safe during pregnancy. The plate shows the trifoliate leaves, flower and long pods.
